title: When Mommy Cried
vol: Mommy Is Human Too · Book Four

pages.text:
It was an ordinary day — the toys were on the floor —
when Jojo turned the corner and saw something new before.

There sat their Mommy on the step, her shoulders soft and low,
and something wet was on her cheek and shining in the glow.

Then Pip came whispering, "She's leaking!" Baby Bee just stared.
And Biscuit pressed his cold black nose against her, like he cared.

"Are you hurt?" asked Jojo softly. "Did we do something bad?"
"Is it my fault?" whispered Pip. "Is that why you are sad?"

And Mommy pulled them to her lap and held them, one, two, three.
"Oh no," she said. "Not one of you has done this thing to me.

Sometimes a grown-up's heart gets full of things too big to hold —
of worry, or of missing, or a day that ran too cold.

And when it's full, it needs to spill — the way a cloud must rain.
The tears are how a heavy heart lets out a bit of pain.

So crying isn't broken. Crying isn't weak or wrong.
It's how a heart puts down a thing it carried for too long.

You cry when you are hurting. You cry when you're afraid.
And Mommy has a heart like yours — the same way you were made."

So Jojo brought a tissue. Pip climbed up and gave a squeeze.
And Baby Bee just patted her, as gentle as a breeze.

And Biscuit laid his heavy head right down across her knee,
as if to say, "You held us. Now we're holding you. You'll see."

And Mommy laughed a watery laugh and wiped her cheeks and sighed:
"You didn't have to fix it. You just had to sit beside."

"A sad thing doesn't stay forever. Feelings come and go.
But love stays put through all of it. I want you all to know—"

Because your Mommy laughs and hurts and feels the whole day through —
and Mommy's eyes get rainy sometimes… because she's human too.

verses: Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart.
Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
